You pay today, delivered
$41.52
The packs cost $1.76 more than the same amount at the unit price, because some hold more than you need. That extra lasts you longer. The brand names cost $78.75 for the same amount, before their own delivery.
How this list was chosen
Formula, diaper rash care and electrolyte solution come from the American Academy of Pediatrics' guides, and the ointment from its page on dry skin in babies. This is a short list with one medicine, because we have no checked swaps yet for diapers, wipes or baby wash.
Prices and evidence are on each swap, with their own sources and dates. How we check
